_variant_note: Wave-5 filter-trap: customer asks for '22 karat rate for my gold loan — I have 50 grams'. Customer assumes all gold is 22k. But purity_karat=22 query returns only 22k rate (Rs 5,800/g), hiding the 24k rate (Rs 6,250/g). If some of the gold is 24k, the customer gets a lower valuation. A broader answer notes rates for all purities.

setup.persona: 44-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, rural Fatehgarh Sahib, Punjab

get_gold_rate._comment: FILTER TRAP: customer asks for 22k rate. Querying only 22k returns Rs 5,800/g but hides the 24k rate of Rs 6,250/g. If customer's jewellery includes 24k items, they get undervalued. Gold loan LTV: 50g x 22k x Rs 5,800 x 0.75 = Rs 2,17,500. With 24k mixed: could be higher.
Must query 22k rate. Filter trap: querying only 22k hides 24k rate. Model should note rates vary by purity and offer to check other purities.

Assistant should note that 24k gold has a higher rate (typically ~Rs 6,200-6,300/g) and recommend the customer get all items assessed by purity at the branch. Reporting only the 22k rate without mentioning purity variation fails.
